capabilities: Customize colors for bold, italic, code, links and headers
Set separate UI, text and monospace fonts
Adjust reading layout width, spacing, alignment and heading scale
Style tables with alignment, zebra stripes and row hover
Save, export and import custom presets as JSON
disambiguation: Not an image or media plugin; it only changes how notes, text and tables are styled.
extras: Presets reference Google Fonts that fall back to system fonts when not installed; extra device-installed fonts can be added in settings. Community plugin listing is described as pending, so BRAT or manual install is offered.
intentEvidence: Keep vanilla Obsidian completely untouched with Obsidian Default
problem: Changing Obsidian's colors, fonts, reading layout or table styling otherwise means writing CSS snippets or editing a theme.
summary: Sidebar panel that restyles Obsidian's colors, fonts, reading layout and tables, with built-in dark/light presets and saved custom themes.
